summary.text: Rusty Black is a Republican state senator who has represented Missouri Senate District 12 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023 and works as an educator.

paragraphs.text: Rusty Black was born in King City, Missouri, lives in Chillicothe, and graduated from King City High School.
He earned a B.S. in agriculture in 1983 and an M.S. in agriculture education in 1993, both from the University of Missouri-Columbia.
His career includes working as an educator with Grand River Technical School.
Black represented House District 7 from 2017 to 2023 before moving to the Senate.

In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Joint Committee on Legislative Research and Rural Economic Development; in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Agriculture, Food Production and Outdoor Resources Committee.
